title: Habit Heatmap & Streaks
noDb: No databases found. Create a database (attribute view) with a Date column and checkbox columns first.
noCheckbox: This database has no checkbox columns. Add one checkbox column per habit.
noDate: This database has no Date column. Add a Date column (or use Created time).
perfectDays: Add a 'perfect days' row (all selected habits done)
how: One row per day in your database, one checkbox column per habit. A day counts as done when its checkbox is ticked. The streak is kept alive until you miss a full day.
moreNote: charts and Pro Excel/PDF export for any database
